seo-description: How the fixed Regeneration Credit supply is allocated, emitted on a halving schedule, and shared between the community pools.
title: Tokenomics
lead: A fixed supply, a predictable emission schedule inspired by Bitcoin's halving, and a burn mechanism tied to the core utility of the system.
distributionLead: Every token exists from genesis, held inside the pools. It is released only as participants earn it for verified work.
allocationLead: The supply is fixed at 1,310,000,000 RC and split across pools, each rewarding one kind of work.

poolPurpose.regenerator: Rewards regenerators for the verified impact of their areas.
poolPurpose.inspector: Rewards inspectors for each inspection they complete.
poolPurpose.researcher: Rewards researchers for valid research and methods.
poolPurpose.developer: Rewards developers for their development reports.
poolPurpose.activist: Rewards activists as their invited users become active.
poolPurpose.validation: Rewards validators for reviewing inspections and reports.
poolPurpose.prelaunch: Allocated at genesis to the people who built the protocol before launch.

emissionLead: The timeline is structured into Eras and Epochs. One Era is 1,152,000 blocks, about six months. One Epoch is 12 Eras, about six years. After each Epoch, the tokens emitted per Era are halved.
emissionChartTitle: Share of a pool emitted per Epoch
emissionChartNote: Each Epoch releases half of what remains, so a pool approaches — but never fully reaches — its full allocation.
rewardsLead: Within each pool, the emission for an Era is split between active users by level. You raise your level by doing the role's work: inspectors per completed inspection, researchers per published research, regenerators by the trees and species recorded in their inspections, and so on.
rewardsFormula: your reward for an Era  =  ( your level  ÷  the total level of your role )  ×  the pool's emission for that Era
deflationTitle: Offset and the path to deflation
deflationLead: The token's core utility is environmental compensation. Retiring a credit burns it — permanently removing it from supply — and returns a contribution certificate. As emissions halve and adoption grows the burn rate, the tokens burned can exceed the tokens emitted, moving the system from an inflationary phase to a deflationary one.
